title: AMP sees $1.5bn flow into platforms

Editor's Choice
Netwealth reports record $36bn FUM in Q1
Netwealth observed record growth over the first quarter of the financial year, with both funds under administration and funds under management increasing by $3.4 billion and $2.4 billion, respectively.
First Sentier lists active ETF
First Sentier has made the First Sentier Global Listed Infrastructure Fund (Hedged) Active ETF available to Australian advisers and investors.
Janus Henderson launches global equities active ETF
Janus Henderson Investors has launched a global equities strategy designed to combine a broad market exposure with research-driven stock selection.
SILC partners with Totality to give clients brokage access
Wholesale trustee The SILC Group (SILC) has partnered with brokerage firm Totality to provide its equity fund manager clients with access to institutional-grade prime brokerage services.
